name: Hana Park
bio:
Hana's meticulous approach to paintwork developed from a childhood fascination with model cars and a family history in automotive repair. She honed her skills through vocational training, focusing on advanced coating techniques and color matching. Her passion for motorsport led her to seek opportunities beyond standard auto body shops, ultimately landing her a role at Meyer Shank Racing. 

Hana views the paint shop as more than just applying color; she sees it as a crucial element of the team's overall performance. Aerodynamics and aesthetics are both impacted by the quality of the paint job. She constantly researches new materials and techniques to improve the finish and durability of the team's vehicles. Her dedication to innovation and her eye for detail make her a valuable asset to the team.

Her colleagues appreciate Hana's collaborative spirit and calm demeanor, especially during high-pressure situations when tight deadlines loom. She has a knack for finding solutions to complex problems, and her ability to see the big picture ensures that her work always aligns with the team's overall goals.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair with subtle layers, often pulled back into a high ponytail during work hours.
physical.description: Hana is petite with a focused gaze and a practical, no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Always keeps a small notebook filled with paint color swatches and formulas.
Listens to K-pop while working, but always has one ear open for team communications.
Meticulously cleans her workspace at the end of each day, regardless of how busy she is.
